metaTitle: How to Pack a Backpacking Pack
description: Pack a backpacking pack in zones: light bulk low, heavy items close to your back mid-pack, daily items on top, with compression and rain liner tips.
directAnswer: Put the sleeping bag low, the heaviest gear in the middle against your back, and rain gear, snacks and first aid on top. Compress the load so it cannot shift and keep it balanced left to right.
